narrative.overview: Nutz Replacer unites the clarity of modern e-commerce with the precision of high-fashion digital styling. The visual language evokes a luxury fashion studio rather than an algorithmic sandbox. It relies on clean architectural whitespace, solid purposeful typography, restrained deep-purple ink accents, and crisp tactile cards.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color economy: 90% light neutrals with deep-purple accent reserved for active intent.
Zero decorative gradients on text; typography is solid, high-contrast, and legible.
Strict touch and accessibility floor: WCAG AA contrast >= 4.5:1, touch targets >= 44x44px, body text >= 14px.

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: The primary accent (#5B3DF0) must occupy <= 10% of any given screen surface. Its rarity signals immediate intent and direction.

rules.name: No Gradient Headings
rules.body: Headings and text must never use decorative gradient clips; use solid #171717 or #5B3DF0.

dos: Always maintain >= 44x44px touch targets on interactive mobile controls.
Always preserve the target person's original facial features, skin tone, hair, and posture.
Condition try-on directly on the garment reference image via dual-panel spatial diffusion.
Use solid text colors with high contrast.
donts: Do NOT use gradient text (bg-clip-text text-transparent) on headings or labels.
Do NOT use emoji in the UI; use Lucide-React SVG icons.
Do NOT drop garment patterns or revert to generic text-only prompting.
Do NOT allow horizontal scroll on mobile artboards or responsive mobile layouts.
Do NOT use font sizes below 14px for body content or below 13px for labels.
